sections.title: 1. General Provisions
paras: 1.1. This Policy governs the processing and protection of personal data provided by the User when using the Contractor’s online platform (the ‘Platform’) available under the domain names: vokalo.ru, vokalo.kg, vokalo.online, and other domains owned by the Contractor.
1.2. ‘User’ means any legally capable individual aged 18 or older who has registered on the Platform or uses its functionality.

1.3. ‘Personal data’ means any information relating to an identified or identifiable User: surname, name, email address, phone number, payment details, order history, and results of content generation (images, audio, text).
1.4. This Policy complies with the Law of the Kyrgyz Republic ‘On Personal Information’ and, where applicable, GDPR.

sections.title: 2. User Consent
paras: 2.1. By providing data during registration, payment, or use of the Platform’s functionality, the User consents to its processing.
2.2. If the User does not agree with the Policy, they must immediately stop using the Platform.

sections.title: 3. Data Processed
paras: 3.1. The Contractor may collect and process:
— surname, name, contact details (phone, e-mail);
— payment details (without storing full card numbers);
— authentication data (login, password, user ID);
— history of generated content (texts, images, audio);
— technical data: IP address, cookies, browser and device information.

sections.title: 4. Purposes of Processing
paras: The Contractor uses data for:
— user registration and identification;
— providing access to the Platform’s functionality;
— recurring payments and subscription renewal;
— maintaining generation history and service personalization;
— sending notifications, emails, and marketing materials;
— analytics and improving the Platform;
— compliance with legal requirements.

sections.title: 5. Processing Principles
paras: 5.1. Data is processed lawfully, fairly, and transparently.
5.2. Collection and use are limited to the purposes specified in this Policy.
5.3. Retention is limited to the service usage period and no longer than necessary to fulfill obligations.

sections.title: 6. Transfer to Third Parties
paras: 6.1. The Contractor may transfer data to:
— payment systems and banks for settlements;
— service providers involved in service delivery (e.g., hosting, analytics, mailings);
— anonymized form only — for marketing and statistics.
6.2. All counterparties must maintain confidentiality and ensure data protection.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and Analytics
paras: 7.1. The Platform uses cookies to remember User preferences and analyze activity.
7.2. Using the Platform implies consent to cookie processing.

sections.title: 8. User Rights
paras: The User has the right to:
— receive information about their data;
— request correction, blocking, or deletion of data;
— withdraw consent to data processing (except where retention is required by law).

sections.title: 9. Data Protection
paras: 9.1. The Contractor implements organizational and technical measures to protect data from unauthorized access and leaks.
9.2. Bank card details are not stored on the Contractor’s servers.

sections.title: 10. Policy Changes
paras: 10.1. The Contractor may update the Policy without prior notice.
10.2. The new version takes effect upon publication on the Platform.

sections.title: 11. Contacts
paras: All questions related to personal data processing should be sent to: {{email}}.
